name: agent-factory
description: Five Agent Factory skills for managed agents, core conventions, source gathering, Original/Processed/Specification Documents, and the Human control-tower workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Agent Factory through five focused skills.
interface.longDescription: Provides five public Skills: Agent for the Main -> Work -> Verification graph, Convention for rules and core semantics, Gather for external source synchronization, Document for Original, Processed, and Specification Document definitions, and Workspace for the Human control tower. Specifications are accepted and reconciled project knowledge with faithful Human/AI representations. Explorer and Interview remain Convention-owned capabilities applied by Work and Main.
defaultPrompt: Use $agent to orchestrate the next request through the appropriate managed role.
